subject: Overlapping billing detected on March invoices — credit & VAT correction request
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@auroraapps.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurora Apps Finance <finance@auroraapps.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Overlapping billing on March invoices — request for credit + VAT correction

Hi Avery,

Quick note from accounting — we discovered two invoices that appear to bill the same ingestion events twice after our channel migration last month. The invoices in question are INV-20270301-12345 and INV-20270301-12346. We also attached a copy of the payment receipt (we paid INV-20270301-12345 in full on 2027-03-02).

We believe the duplication came from our reseller channel (Atlas Resell) being active at the same time as our direct account transition; both connectors reported identical traffic for 2027-03-01 — 2027-03-03. Total duplicated amount by our calculation: €2,540.00.

Because this is an EU entity, VAT treatment matters — Aurora Apps is headquartered in NL (VAT NL123456789). Please confirm whether Redwood will issue a credit note with reverse charge treatment (0% VAT) or reissue invoices with corrected VAT. We need a corrected VAT document for our month-end close on 2027-03-31.

Attachments: (attachment: INV-20270301-12345.pdf), (attachment: payment_receipt_2027-03-02.pdf)

Can you confirm receipt and estimated timeline?

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Finance Operations Manager
Aurora Apps
M: +31 6 1234 5678

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@auroraapps.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 10:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Overlapping billing on March invoices — request for credit + VAT correction

Hi Maya — thanks for flagging this and for the attachments. Confirmed that we received your payment receipt. I’m looping in Laura (billing) and Ben (ops) to investigate the meter logs and confirm whether those two invoices include overlapping events.

High level: we will either (a) issue a credit note for the duplicated amount and apply it to your April invoice, or (b) reissue corrected invoices if VAT treatment requires it. We should be able to provide an interim update within 48 business hours and a final resolution (credit note or corrected invoice) by 2027-03-15.

To help speed this, could you share the transaction IDs for the Atlas Resell channel (if available) and confirm whether Aurora prefers a credit applied to the next invoice or a refund?

Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com
(attachment: none)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 11:18:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Overlapping billing on March invoices — request for credit + VAT correction

Avery / team — did a preliminary audit of the ingestion logs and billing pipeline. Findings:
- Root cause: our reseller bridge (reseller_plugin_v2) and direct connector both emitted the same pipeline events for Aurora’s account for 2027-03-01 to 2027-03-03 due to an overlap window during the marketplace-to-direct migration.
- Impacted meter lines: connector_ingest_tokens and connector_requests.
- Calculated duplicated gross amount: €2,540.00. Net of our standard usage discounts, the gross duplication is what appears on the invoices.

Recommendation: issue a credit note (service credit) covering €2,540.00 and apply reverse-charge VAT treatment on the credit note (i.e., CN will show 0% VAT with a note referencing Aurora’s VAT ID). Accounting: please confirm if we should apply credit to the April invoice or process an immediate refund. Legal / Billing: confirm wording for goodwill vs service-credit language — Aurora specifically asked for correct VAT documentation for their month-end close.

I’ve attached a draft credit note and the usage report slice for the period. (attachment: draft_credit_note_CNDRAFT-43912.pdf), (attachment: usage_report_mar-2027.csv)

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@auroraapps.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@auroraapps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Finance Team <billing@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:02:00 +0100
Subject: Resolution: credit note issued for duplicated March usage (CN-20270315-43912)

Hi Maya / Tom — following up with a resolution. Thank you for the patience while we investigated.

Summary of outcome:
- We verified the duplicate metering spanning 2027-03-01 to 2027-03-03.
- Redwood will issue Credit Note CN-20270315-43912 for €2,540.00 to correct the duplication. The credit note will be issued with reverse-charge VAT treatment referencing Aurora Apps VAT NL123456789 so it meets your EU reporting needs.
- Credit application: the credit will be applied to your April 2027 invoice automatically. If you prefer a refund instead, let me know and our billing team will process it (refund lead time ~5–7 business days).

Attachments: (attachment: credit_note_AUR-43912.pdf), (attachment: usage_report_mar-2027.csv)

How this will appear in the portal: the credit note will show under Account > Documents and will reduce the April invoice balance. The accounting memo on the CN includes a short explanation and a pointer to the meter logs.

Next steps:
- Please confirm whether you want the credit applied to April or a refund.
- If all good, we’ll finalize the CN on our side and provide any additional VAT documentation you need for month-end.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
